serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
It’s been a day. I wonder how Melissa is doing.
I can tell that {f_botName} is still shaken about what happened. I don’t even want to imagine how Melissa is handling it since the blow to her was probably much bigger.
She was caught by surprise by these bastards… {{wi}}It was the worst timing possible.
I thought that these cops were just dumb, but it turns out they are dumb and evil.
I need to call Melissa and check on her. 
…
She’s not picking up.
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: Were you calling Melissa?
You: Yeah, I was. She did not answer.
Bot: I don’t like her very much, but seeing her back then was very frustrating, even for me.
Bot: Do you think we will see her ever again?
You: Of course we will! Why would you ask that?
Bot: I did not understand her reaction. If it’s not true, why didn’t she just laugh it off?
You: I don’t know what was going through her head, but that wasn’t an easy situation to handle for anyone.
Bot: You are right. It’s just that I sometimes forget she’s an older model and that she probably cannot come up with the best possible solution to everything like me.
You: I will try to catch her tomorrow after her shift. Annalie was really excited for that makeover, so she probably wouldn’t want to keep her waiting.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: You are right! I’m sure everything will be fine!
